manual.p: If we don't want to write the module name every time we use something from that module, an alternative is to import the module. If we import Protocols.HTTP, we can use the data type Query, and the method get_url, without prefixing them with Protocols.HTTP:
Although you could import lots and lots of modules for the ease of lazy typing, this mostly isn't a recommended practice, for obvious reasons of clarity and readability.
